prompt: Make a round coaster, 90 mm across and 4 mm thick, with a 2 mm raised rim around the edge. Make the diameter a parameter.
source: Written by hand (Claude Opus 5.5) as a typical response to the prompt, for the first video pass; replace with a recorded run (demo API recordAgent) when an API key is available.

content.text: I'll make the diameter a parameter first, so the coaster resizes from one number. Then a 4 mm disc, and a rim on top.
Now the rim: a 2 mm ring, 3 mm wide, joined on top.
Done: a 90 mm coaster, 4 mm thick, with a 3 mm wide rim standing 2 mm proud. The diameter is the parameter `diameter`, so you can resize the whole thing from the Parameters panel.
